tool_schema.description:
Draft the participant's chosen goal and their own success measure; never starts coaching.

Ask for all fields first. check_in_days uses Monday=1 through Sunday=7; check_in_time
is local HH:MM. Do not invent a goal, measure, or cadence from emotional conversation.
tool_schema.name: draft_program

tool_schema.description: Extend only after explicit participant intent, by 1–14 days; never automatically.
tool_schema.name: extend_program

tool_schema.description: Pause the owned Program immediately when explicitly requested.
tool_schema.name: pause_program

tool_schema.description: Offer a request to another declared Mode. Nothing executes until the participant confirms.
tool_schema.name: propose_handoff

carried_request.description: The exact request shown to the participant before confirmation.

target_mode_id.description: A handoff target declared by this Mode.

tool_schema.description: Record only progress explicitly reported by the participant; never infer improvement.
tool_schema.name: record_progress

tool_schema.description: Record the participant's continue, adjust, pause, or stop choice. Continue never extends.
tool_schema.name: record_weekly_choice

tool_schema.description: Resume an explicitly requested paused Program within its existing approved term.
tool_schema.name: resume_program

tool_schema.description: Revise an explicitly requested draft; approval of the exact revised summary is required.
tool_schema.name: revise_program

tool_schema.description: Stop the owned Program immediately when requested; stopped Programs cannot resume.
tool_schema.name: stop_program
